title: On Safe Spawning Grounds
description: A school of longnose gar (Lepisosteus osseus) gather near a patch of floating vegetation in Ichetucknee Springs, Florida. The vegetation mats serve as essential spawning grounds for these prehistoric fish, helping them avoid predators. Spawning only occurs a few days between April and June each year. But the rise of boat traffic and ecotourism is leading to efforts to remove the vegetation from parks and waterways.
translated_description: 一群长吻雀鳝（Lepisosteus osseus）聚集在佛罗里达州伊切图克尼泉附近的一片漂浮植被旁。这些植被垫是这种史前鱼类重要的产卵场所，有助于它们躲避捕食者。产卵期仅在每年四月至六月间的短短数日内。然而，随着船只往来增多和生态旅游发展，人们正试图从公园和水道中清除这些植被。
